rule: GOAL: Clear the level by performing exactly three actions. CONTROLS: Clicking objects or background areas registers as an action but causes no visible change to the board. RULE: Success is determined solely by the action count reaching the target, regardless of where you click. TRAP: Believing you must manipulate the yellow component into the black bar or move the blue squares to win.

GOAL: Navigate the grid maze to reach the green target node. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step through open corridors. RULE: Only even-coordinate rooms are valid; odd coordinates are walls or narrow passages. TRAP: Assuming the green marker sits in a room rather than a corridor led to wrong destination calculations.

GOAL: Move the purple token along a diagonal chain of dots to the end. CONTROLS: Clicking the immediate next dot swaps your position with it. RULE: You can only swap with the adjacent dot; long-range clicks are ignored. TRAP: Believing you could jump multiple steps by clicking a distant dot wasted turns.

GOAL: Hide all eight colored tokens simultaneously using two crosses. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross; Space switches between yellow and blue crosses. RULE: A token is hidden only when covered by a cross arm’s current position. TRAP: Assuming tokens stay hidden after moving; they only count if covered at the final moment.

GOAL: Align the third block's edge to the target marker. CONTROLS: Clicking below the first bar shifts the top two blocks; clicking below the second bar shifts the middle and bottom blocks. RULE: The middle block acts as a buffer; you must push it right first to create room for it to move left later. TRAP: Clicking the second bar repeatedly stalls when the middle block hits its left limit, requiring you to reset its position first.

GOAL: Clear the first level in two moves. CONTROLS: Arrows move the paddle; Space launches the ball. RULE: The ball bounces off walls and the paddle to hit all blocks. TRAP: Overcomplicating the ball’s path with complex math, when it is just a simple diagonal bounce.

GOAL: Match each dial's number to its partner's value shown above. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; up/down spin the dial. RULE: Spin each dial until it displays the correct partner number. TRAP: Assuming you must visit every slot; only change dials that are wrong.

GOAL: Cover all gray bar segments with dropped rings. CONTROLS: Arrows move; SPACE absorbs bumped boxes or drops rings. RULE: Absorb boxes to extend your ring, then drop it to fill gaps. TRAP: Thinking boxes are permanent obstacles; they are actually fuel for your ring.

GOAL: Collect red tokens hidden under a rotating diamond while managing blue cross overlaps. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; SPACE activates special items or toggles states. RULE: Tokens are only collectable when not covered by shape outlines; overlap hides them. TRAP: Assuming visible red pixels are always tokens; they may be part of the diamond shape itself, leading to wasted moves trying to collect non-existent items.

GOAL: Arrange seven bottom yellow tiles to match a seven-item sequence generated by four top pink tiles. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the white selector; pressing the action button rotates the selected tile to its next color. RULE: The target sequence is strictly defined by the specific yellow tiles linked to each pink tile in the top row. TRAP: Assuming the target order matches the visual left-to-right arrangement of top tiles, rather than following the exact linked-pair concatenation.

GOAL: Decode the blue glyph row by cycling through the dial until the target pattern appeared. CONTROLS: Arrows rotated the selected slot’s glyph value within its cycle. RULE: Each slot cycled through a fixed sequence of six distinct blue types. TRAP: Assuming the cycle length matched the seven types found in earlier levels.

GOAL: Extract the plug tip past the notch by shrinking it. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the tip; clicks adjusted the stripe pattern to trigger success. RULE: Each success reduced the tip’s height, allowing it to fit through the narrower notch section. TRAP: Assuming the tip could pass the notch while four rows tall, ignoring the need to shrink it first.

GOAL: Move three objects to cover eight hidden tokens. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active object three spaces. Space cycles the active object. RULE: Tokens hide when an object overlaps the box, not just the token cell. TRAP: Assuming movement is one space per press wasted many actions.

GOAL: Match the bottom row by following two-step chains hidden in the top pairs. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the yellow dial slot to select the correct final color. RULE: Blue leads to pink, and pink leads to yellow, so blue ultimately becomes yellow. TRAP: Do not map blue directly to yellow; you must pass through the intermediate pink step first.

GOAL: Merge two purple squares, then move the yellow result into the blue ball. CONTROLS: Clicking within eight pixels of objects merges or moves them to a new position. RULE: Merging requires exactly two same-colored items in range; moving requires one item. TRAP: Assuming the ball blocks actions. It does not, so you can click near it to push tokens inside.

GOAL: Guide the shrunken tip through the narrow shaft into the head. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; keypad clicks trigger the shrink mechanic. RULE: The tip must become narrow enough to pass the bottleneck before moving up. TRAP: Pushing the full-sized tip up first jams it in the passage, wasting turns.

GOAL: Lift the white block until the colored plug aligns with the green target zone. CONTROLS: Left and Right buttons shift the block horizontally; Up button raises the block and plug together. RULE: The block stops rising if the plug hits the top of the frame or a higher bar. TRAP: Assuming the block can rise indefinitely; it actually hits an invisible ceiling when the plug reaches the frame's upper boundary.

GOAL: Reach the exit while navigating past a lethal red enemy. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step per press. RULE: The red enemy instantly kills the player if they enter its row within range. TRAP: Assuming you can safely stand in the enemy's row if you are not adjacent.

ESTABLISHED: The beam only pushes items when its columns overlap the item's columns, not just rows. Capturing new items keeps existing skewered items in place without pushing them. FAILED: Attempting to move items by sweeping the beam across their rows without column overlap. GOAL IS NOT: Using row alignment alone to push distant items into position. CONTROLS: UP and DOWN move the beam vertically. Extending the beam captures items at the tip. Retracting pulls items left but not past each other.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking grid cells toggles dark/light states. No configuration tested so far has cleared the level. FAILED: Clicking the droplet center, background areas, and specific bar/stem patterns (width, height, checkerboard) produced no change or win. GOAL IS NOT: A simple pattern match on the visible grid, nor a hidden button located at the droplet or edges. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell flips its state. No other interactive elements have responded to input.

GOAL: Guide two shapes into their matching circles. CONTROLS: Clicking near a shape moves it toward the circle. RULE: Each click shifts the shape by a fixed, limited distance. TRAP: Thinking clicks move shapes directly to the cursor; they actually nudge them step-by-step.

GOAL: Navigate to the exit while bypassing deadly red guards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in that direction. RULE: Entering a guard's cell from a perpendicular side destroys it safely. TRAP: Thinking guards move; they are static, so only their facing direction matters.

GOAL: Cover all tokens using two shapes, one per color. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space swaps between them. RULE: Each shape must match the color of the tokens it covers. TRAP: Assuming shapes could overlap colors or ignore them wastes moves on impossible paths.

GOAL: Align all tiles to the target number sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selector; UP dials tiles forward. RULE: Tiles lockstep, meaning both glyphs on a tile must be identical to match. TRAP: Assuming adjacent unequal numbers form a valid pair; only equal adjacent values are reachable.

GOAL: Arrange colored tokens into empty slots to match the top row's color sequence. CONTROLS: Click a token to select it, then click a slot to place it. RULE: The top row displays the exact left-to-right order required for completion. TRAP: Assuming the box’s gray dots were hidden clues, when they were just empty placeholders.

GOAL: Extend both colored bars until their tips align precisely with the distant red plus markers. CONTROLS: Clicking a bar's knob grows it; clicking the opposite end shrinks it. RULE: Each click moves the bar tip by exactly three units, requiring careful counting. TRAP: Assuming you could overshoot the target; the bars stop moving once they hit the plus marker.

GOAL: Guide two tokens to meet in the center of a split maze. CONTROLS: Arrows move both tokens; the right token’s left/right inputs are inverted. RULE: Horizontal commands push tokens toward the center, creating a mirror effect. TRAP: Assuming standard directional controls for the right token causes collisions and wasted moves.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to match the hidden pattern. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows spin the ring; clicking tiles does nothing. RULE: Only rotation changes the state; alignment with the top markers wins. TRAP: Clicking individual tiles wastes moves, as they are fixed to the ring.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single peg by making exactly two valid jumps. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click an empty landing spot to jump over an adjacent peg and remove it. RULE: A jump is legal only if an adjacent peg is followed immediately by an empty space in a straight line. TRAP: Assuming the selected peg stays highlighted after landing; you often need to click the new position again to select it for the next move.

GOAL: Position the blob's center exactly on the target ring. CONTROLS: Click a gem to move the white token to that spot; clicking the green gem swaps the two tokens' positions. RULE: The blob always forms at the midpoint between the white and green tokens, so aligning this midpoint with the ring solves the level. TRAP: Assuming moving the white token directly to the ring solves it, forgetting that the green token's position dictates the blob's actual center.

GOAL: Arrange colored tokens into rings so their sequence matches the scan. CONTROLS: Click tokens to move them between slots and rings; press space to verify the arrangement. RULE: The scanner advances rings only when matching colors are found, skipping non-matching slots. TRAP: Assuming every visible slot consumes a ring position; non-matches are actually ignored during the scan.

GOAL: Guide two tokens to merge in the same cell without touching hazards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both tokens simultaneously in the chosen direction. RULE: If either token hits a hazard, both die; only safe paths allow merging. TRAP: Assuming hazards are one-way or that only the moving token dies causes fatal errors.

GOAL: Place seven tokens into specific slots across three colored boxes to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Click a token from the bottom tray, then click a slot in the upper grid to place it. RULE: Ring colors on the main grid indicate which bottom box receives the token for that position. TRAP: Assuming slots align vertically; the green and blue boxes are offset horizontally from their corresponding rings.

GOAL: Arrange the seven rings to match the fixed sequence while inserting the green box into the red chain. CONTROLS: Drag the green ring into the red box to set insertion points, then place other rings into the resulting empty slots. RULE: The ring position dictates where the green box interrupts the red sequence, ensuring the pre-placed green ring lands on its correct numerical spot. TRAP: Assuming the ring position is irrelevant; placing it incorrectly shifts the green box, breaking the alignment with the fixed green ring.

GOAL: Match tile colors to the pinwheel pattern’s white segments. CONTROLS: Click to toggle between red and neutral states. RULE: A tile turns red if and only if its corresponding pinwheel segment is white. TRAP: Assuming all pinwheel segments are equal; ignoring the gray segments causes mismatches.

GOAL: Rotate the block’s dial to match the target symbol before entering the box. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; moving off and back onto the plus rotates the dial 90 degrees clockwise. RULE: The dial rotates only when covering the plus tile, regardless of approach direction. TRAP: Assuming rotation depends on movement direction or trying to enter the box with a mismatched dial.

GOAL: Place tokens to satisfy a hidden sequence rule. CONTROLS: Click tray items to place them on slots; press space to test. RULE: Two ring slots must contain identical token sequences from a side box. TRAP: Assuming rings are just placeholders; they actually enforce strict sequence matching.

GOAL: Paint specific grid tiles orange to match the hidden pattern revealed by the two overlapping pinwheel puzzles. CONTROLS: Clicking a blue tile toggles it to orange. The pinwheel centers indicate the target color, while their arms define the rules for surrounding cells. RULE: A tile must be orange if the corresponding position in the pinwheel’s arm pattern is white. Gray positions remain blue. TRAP: Assuming the target color stays red. The orange pinwheel center signals that tiles must turn orange, not red, despite the blue starting state.

GOAL: Arrange three colored rings to lock the insertion order of three sub-boxes, then fill their empty slots with matching tray tokens to build a specific top sequence. CONTROLS: Click to move rings into the order bracket and tokens into box slots. Press Space to confirm the final arrangement. RULE: The left-to-right ring order dictates which box appears first, second, and third in the final concatenated sequence. TRAP: Assuming box positions are fixed; the ring order determines the sequence, not the physical layout of the boxes.

GOAL: Align two moving markers to specific target rows. CONTROLS: Red cycles the first row; green shifts the second row. RULE: Only vertical positions matter; horizontal alignment is irrelevant to the win condition. TRAP: Assuming green moves in the opposite direction of red wastes actions verifying direction instead of trusting the cycle.

GOAL: Assign colors to grid cells based on pinwheel hints, turning specific tiles orange or blue while keeping others red. CONTROLS: Click a tile to cycle its color through red, blue, and orange until it matches the target state. RULE: White hint blocks indicate the pinwheel’s center color; gray blocks indicate the tile must be the third, unused color. TRAP: Assuming only two colors exist or that gray hints match the center color, leading to incorrect tile assignments.

ESTABLISHED: The corridor is passable floor. Seating the left token in the ring does not open the door. The door state remains unchanged regardless of token positions tested so far. FAILED: Moving the left token to the ring. Moving the corridor token left into the panel while the ring is occupied. Assuming simple proximity triggers the door. GOAL IS NOT: Simply covering the left ring. Placing any token near the right ring. Ignoring the corridor's state. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected token. Tab switches tokens. The door opens only under unconfirmed specific conditions.

ESTABLISHED: The red block is static. The left corridor is the only path to the chamber, but it is blocked by the red block at rows 38-42. FAILED: Moving down four times did not move the red block or clear the path. GOAL IS NOT: Simply walking past the red block or finding an alternate route around it. CONTROLS: Movement keys shift the player. No action keys have revealed a way to move the obstacle.

GOAL: Place the yellow ring on the left gear and the orange ring on the right gear without blocking each other. CONTROLS: Click the top arrows to rotate the left gear, and the bottom arrows to rotate the right gear. RULE: Rings sitting on shared central slots move with either gear, while outer rings only move with their own gear. TRAP: Moving a ring to a shared slot early seems efficient, but it forces you to rotate both gears later, wasting moves.

GOAL: Paint all tiles to match hidden color rules defined by three pinwheel centers. CONTROLS: Click any tile to cycle its color through blue, orange, and red. RULE: White marks indicate a tile matches its pinwheel’s center color; gray marks exclude that color. TRAP: Assuming every tile is directly claimed by a pinwheel; most tiles rely solely on elimination.

GOAL: Expand nested boxes to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click tray items to select, click slots to place, space to confirm. RULE: Rings expand into boxes, allowing deeper nesting than simple substitution. TRAP: Assuming rings only fit the outermost box ignores the nesting logic.

GOAL: Rotate and slide the plug so its prongs align with the socket tabs. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug in three-cell increments; Space rotates it ninety degrees clockwise. RULE: Prong spacing and size match the tabs exactly when facing right, confirming the target orientation. TRAP: Assuming rotation keeps the plug centered causes misalignment; always re-measure position after every turn.

GOAL: Align two symbols on a shared grid intersection. CONTROLS: Click arrows to shift entire rows or columns. RULE: Shifts move all tiles in a line, wrapping around edges. TRAP: Assuming moves affect only adjacent tiles, not the whole line.

GOAL: Slide the dark shape onto the yellow target while its mirror image follows symmetrically. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the dark piece three cells per press; the black piece mirrored horizontal moves and matched vertical moves. RULE: Horizontal movement was inverted between the two pieces, requiring you to press the opposite arrow to align both shapes. TRAP: Assuming both pieces moved identically horizontally caused wasted actions; they actually moved in opposite directions along the X-axis.

ESTABLISHED: The left assembly and podium shapes do not match, even when rotated. FAILED: Attempting to fit the blue block and box A into the podium slot via rotation or alignment. GOAL IS NOT: Placing the left panel assembly directly into the podium structure. CONTROLS: Toggling gates and moving the dot through the 3x3 grid changes connections but has not triggered completion.

GOAL: Place shapes to cover specific colored tokens. CONTROLS: Arrows move cursor; Space places shape. RULE: Shapes snap to a grid, restricting valid positions. TRAP: Assuming any nearby spot works; alignment constraints caused wasted moves.

GOAL: Align all markers to the target row. CONTROLS: Click a column to shift its marker up or down. RULE: Markers in adjacent columns move together, but the clicked column moves twice as far. TRAP: Thinking the top dashes counted remaining moves; they only track overall level progress, causing wasted hesitation.

ESTABLISHED: The stamp face is 7x12. At 0 degrees, it paints a 7-wide horizontal band. Rotation changes the painted shape's orientation. FAILED: Pressing space at 0 degrees only paints the top rows, missing the bottom target area. GOAL IS NOT: A simple horizontal stripe across the entire width. CONTROLS: Left rotates the mould counter-clockwise; Right rotates clockwise; Space presses the stamp down.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking a gem removes it. The player rises through open spaces after removals. Gems block upward movement. FAILED: Moving directly under a gem does not remove it; a click is required. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the top without clearing the blocking gems above. CONTROLS: Click gems to remove them. Move left or right to position the player under a target.

GOAL: Slide the gray shape left onto the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows shift pieces; SPACE toggles the moving strip. RULE: With the strip active, arrows move the gray six steps and the strip three. TRAP: Believing the black piece fits; only the gray matches the yellow's shape.

GOAL: Reach the glowing pink plus sign at the top of the maze. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one grid square in the pressed direction. RULE: The pink plus marks the exit; standing on it completes the level. TRAP: Assuming black areas are just background; they are solid walls that block movement.

GOAL: Align the moving shape so its mirror image perfectly covers the hidden target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the active piece; spacebar cycles selection between the strip and two shapes. RULE: The strip acts as a mirror; the active shape’s reflection determines where the gray copy appears. TRAP: Assuming dots indicate the active piece’s color; they actually show the target color beneath.

GOAL: Place three yellow blocks into specific target slots to finish the level. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate clusters or swap middle tiles, moving blocks step by step. RULE: Yellow blocks must land exactly on the marked goal cells; only correct placement counts. TRAP: Thinking any yellow block works; you must track each block’s position, as wrong ones block progress.

GOAL: Set all tiles to match the final pinwheel centers. CONTROLS: Click pinwheels to swap their center colors; click tiles to change their hue. RULE: Match the tile color to the pinwheel center if the touching block is the background color, not the marker. TRAP: Assuming the marker color dictates the rule for magenta pinwheels leads to contradictions.

GOAL: Guide the sliding block into the glowing head target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the block four spaces until it hits a wall. RULE: Movement is a fixed four-space leap, not a single step. TRAP: Assuming one key press moves one space wastes turns and breaks alignment.

GOAL: Mirror black shapes across a horizontal axis to cover yellow targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active piece; Space cycles to the next piece. RULE: Flip the vertical coordinate around the central line to find the target position. TRAP: Assuming pieces move independently; you must cycle through them to position each one.

GOAL: Reach the exit while dodging a patrolling enemy and managing a depleting health bar. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; the enemy moves one step per player turn. RULE: The enemy follows a fixed cycle; time your moves to slip past its current position safely. TRAP: Assuming the enemy moves randomly or that you can outrun the health drain without precise timing.

ESTABLISHED: Wall two's window accepts water from strip three, but the yellow band sits higher than the water's maximum reach. FAILED: Pumping strip three to its absolute limit fails to trigger the win condition or move the plug. GOAL IS NOT: Simply filling the lower windows or raising the water level to the maximum possible height. CONTROLS: Clicking specific coordinates pumps water between adjacent strips, altering levels without moving the plug horizontally.

GOAL: Clear the level in exactly four clicks. CONTROLS: Mouse clicks select and move blocks; arrow keys shift view. RULE: Blocks slide until they hit a wall or another block. TRAP: Assuming clicks consume step budget; the side bar is a timer, not a move counter.

GOAL: Move two colored chains to their target zones without mixing them up. CONTROLS: Click a gem to swap its position with your cursor. RULE: A chain is solved when its center point lands on the correct ring. TRAP: Thinking you can move one gem alone; swaps always happen in pairs, so plan your path to keep the center stable.

GOAL: Clear the path by destroying obstacles to reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the marker; keypad clicks activate specific tile patterns. RULE: Green tiles refill your action bar, allowing you to bypass movement limits. TRAP: Assuming the action bar only decreases; ignoring green tiles causes early failure.

GOAL: Align the plus bars to pass through the gray gap. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches between the plus and the W. RULE: The vertical bar stops moving if it touches the gray zone, allowing independent positioning. TRAP: Assuming both bars move together; the vertical bar can be blocked while the horizontal bar continues, requiring separate alignment steps.

GOAL: Align a block shape with a target zone using minimal moves. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active part; Space cycles focus between horizontal, vertical, and block. RULE: Only the focused part moves; ensure the correct component is active before moving. TRAP: Assuming every Space press cycles in a predictable order or that one press registers if the game lags.

GOAL: Park three small tokens to clear walls, then navigate two big tokens to merge. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move active tokens; clicking switches between small and big modes. RULE: Small tokens block big tokens' paths, so park them precisely before switching modes. TRAP: Assuming big tokens can pass through parked small ones; they cannot, requiring careful pre-positioning.

GOAL: Reach the marked cell while dodging moving obstacles. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step. RULE: Obstacles bounce off walls in fixed patterns. TRAP: Assuming obstacles stay put leads to collisions.

ESTABLISHED: Liquid rises from the magenta block, fills open spaces upward, and spreads sideways when hitting ceilings. FAILED: Assuming the liquid starts at the dark pedestal below the source. GOAL IS NOT: Simply filling the entire bottom row or the starting column. CONTROLS: The game auto-simulates flow; no manual movement commands were issued during the liquid's rise.

GOAL: Reach the goal by navigating left and rising through a removed gem. CONTROLS: Left moves the player horizontally; clicking a gem removes it. RULE: The player rises automatically through empty space above until hitting a solid block. TRAP: Believing you can move left freely under gems; an open column above triggers an unexpected rise, forcing you to stop early.

GOAL: Enter red tiles from the side to destroy them, clearing the path to the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; enemies patrol fixed routes automatically. RULE: Red tiles vanish when entered perpendicularly, but moving through them directly triggers a fail state. TRAP: Assuming you can pass through red tiles; they block you unless destroyed by a specific side-entry maneuver.

GOAL: Route the player to the box within the action limit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; the ring refills your energy. RULE: Your energy drains two units per move, limiting each leg to twenty-one steps. TRAP: Assuming one drain per move causes a fatal energy shortage before the final push.

ESTABLISHED: The card is a 6x6 object moving in discrete steps of six columns. It currently occupies the horizontal corridor segment. FAILED: Pressing UP from the current position did not move the card into the vertical channel. GOAL IS NOT: Simply sliding the card to the far right edge of the horizontal corridor. CONTROLS: RIGHT moves the card six columns east. LEFT moves it west. UP is currently ineffective at this location.

GOAL: Navigate a grid to reach the exit in eight moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the player one step between connected rooms. RULE: The guard changed colors every turn, signaling when it would attack its column. TRAP: Believing the guard only moved when you did, rather than acting on its own timer.

GOAL: Align three bars to form the target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows move the blue bar; clicking a red bar swaps its color with the blue one. RULE: Only the blue bar responds to movement keys; color determines control. TRAP: Trying to move a red bar directly; you must click it first to make it blue.

GOAL: Move two large tokens to merge in the center corridor. CONTROLS: Arrows move all active tokens; clicks switch which pair is active. RULE: Only clicked tokens move; others freeze until clicked again. TRAP: Assuming all tokens move simultaneously; forgetting to switch control wastes turns.

GOAL: Reach the exit while evading a pursuing shadow. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one step in a direction. RULE: The shadow only activates when you approach, then chases your previous position. TRAP: Assuming the shadow is asleep just because it hasn’t moved yet.

ESTABLISHED: A white vertical strip on the far left edge acts as a shrinking step counter, not a character. The current grid state is static until a specific interaction occurs. FAILED: Clicking near the left edge did not move the player; it only registered as HUD interaction or failed input. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the left edge or depleting the white bar without solving the gem logic. CONTROLS: Clicking purple gems triggers state changes; clicking the left-edge bar wastes steps without moving the player.

GOAL: Guide both tokens to the exit tiles. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the left token normally, but the right token moves in the opposite direction. RULE: Doors only open when a token stands on a matching colored plate, blocking movement until the condition is met. TRAP: Assuming both tokens move in the same direction wastes turns; remember the right token mirrors your input.

ESTABLISHED: The plug is too long to fit the narrow slot. FAILED: Aligning tips on tabs and inserting into the wide slot. GOAL IS NOT: Placing tips on tabs or fitting the 18x3 bar. CONTROLS: Rotation changes plug orientation; movement shifts position.

ESTABLISHED: Five object colors exist, but only three token colors appear. FAILED: Covering all tokens simultaneously with mismatched colors; moving the pink object. GOAL IS NOT: Covering every token at once with its matching color. CONTROLS: Space cycles objects; arrows move them; passing slots changes color.

ESTABLISHED: Only one knob exists, the green one. The green piston's bar tip is anchored; growing moves the cap away. Yellow has no visible knob. FAILED: Assuming yellow has a hidden knob. Assuming the knob stays fixed while the bar lengthens. Assuming the knob is at the bar's base. GOAL IS NOT: Finding yellow's knob. Keeping the green knob stationary. CONTROLS: Growing the piston moves the entire green structure, including the knob, away from the anchor point.

GOAL: Reach the top goal by climbing through a tower of blocks and sockets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; clicks swap block and socket states. RULE: Players rise automatically when walking onto an open cell below a column. TRAP: Leaving a column open causes premature rises, blocking horizontal movement toward the goal.
